goal: Replace blakra.us with a new React site that tells one true, story-driven narrative with Awwwards-level motion and converts visitors into discovery calls.
note: v4 shipped locally: black-hole + chakra stage, scroll-driven camera, 4 languages. 89 unit tests, 102/102 e2e, Lighthouse mobile 92–94/100/100/100. Reviews: UX 10 (8 fixed), code 6 (6 fixed), security 3 (3 fixed). Not deployed, not committed (no git repo).

acceptance_criteria.text: Reduced motion or toggle off: no pin, scrub, Lenis or shader animation; scenes show final state

acceptance_criteria.text: Every number and claim traces to the confirmed facts in spec.md
acceptance_criteria.evidence: src/content/FACTS.md lists every claim with its source; placeholders flagged DRAFT (dev badge) and listed for the owner

acceptance_criteria.text: Form: valid posts {org,email,msg}; invalid shows announced inline error; honeypot or <3 s sends nothing
